## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat(python): resolve relative imports`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm test` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (README / CONTRIBUTING / CHANGELOG) if behavior changed
- [ ] No language-specific code in `src/core/`; language logic lives in `src/languages/<lang>/`
- [ ] PR is small and focused on one thing
